posts.title: Voice messages, pins, stars and disappearing messages
posts.summary: Record and send voice messages with a waveform. Pin messages for everyone, star them for yourself, and browse pinned, starred, media, files and links from one library. Chats can now delete messages automatically after 5 minutes, 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: Chat search, group read receipts and notifications
posts.summary: Search inside a chat with highlighted matches. In groups you can see who has read your message (Seen by), and read receipts can be turned off. Optional browser notifications, per-chat mute and an unread count in the tab title.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: Polls, reactions, replies and edit/delete in chat
posts.summary: Tap a message for reactions, reply, copy, edit and delete (for me or for everyone). Create polls with visible, changeable votes from the chart button. Delivered ticks now reach the sender too.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: Link previews in chat
posts.summary: Links in chat are now clickable and show a preview card with title, description and image. Previews are fetched by a Cloudflare function (Open Graph), can be turned off in Settings, and are skipped for encrypted messages.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: GitHub sign-in picks up your GitHub username
posts.summary: After signing in with GitHub, the chat now reads your username from the GitHub API.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: Email sign-in and readable Chat IDs
posts.summary: You can now sign in with an email and password (with verification), and Chat IDs are easier to read.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: Back up your chats to Google Drive
posts.summary: Chats can now be backed up to your Google Drive.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

posts.title: TURN fallback for calls
posts.summary: Calls now have a TURN relay fallback, plus clearer routing notices and call signaling through the call log.
posts.author: ProElectricCoder

cards.title: Try DeepBlue IDE
cards.text: A web-based IDE with GitHub integration, AI assistance, in-browser Python, real-time collaboration and zero-knowledge encryption.

cards.title: Try ChatRooms
cards.text: Peer-to-peer chat rooms on WebRTC, with direct mode that needs no sign-in, calls, and optional Google Drive backup.

cards.title: Try SEP Encryptor
cards.text: Encrypt files with a 1024-byte base-256 stream key, optionally layered with AES-GCM and PBKDF2 key derivation.
